value.title: La spada di Ouken
value.synopsis: Just as things are getting desperate and it looks like Seitou is going to be killed by Fuuki, she is saved by Haku Gessho. Seitou and Suusu are whisked away by the mysterious fox spirit woman to watch the fight unravel from a safe distance, but Seitou is unable to sit still and goes after Fuuki again. All attempts to make Fuuki remember his past life and the time he and Seitou spent together seem to not matter as he continues to attack Seitou. In desperation Seitou puts her own life on the line to remind her former lover of how much they once meant to each other.

value.title: L'obiettivo dell'imperatore delle montagne del Nord
value.synopsis: As Oh Fuuki and the others are escaping the Tosan theater they encounter the Four Heavenly Kings and dispose of all but one easily. The remaining member, known as the Hundred Youkai King, proves to be especially challenging and without a single magical tool at his disposal, Oh Fuuki runs away leaving Seito and the others to handle things on their own. Meanwhile, with Koko's consciousness under Touhou Gessho's control, Suusu has returned to normal. Having subdued the Northern Mountain Emperor, Yaya has gone off to deal with the leader of the black fox spirits, but some surprising words from Sashi encourage him to break his icey prison.

value.title: Lacrime di vuoto contro lacrime di vuoto
value.synopsis: Trying to escape from the Northern Mountain Emperor and his violent rampage, Haku Gessho is stopped by Suusu noticing that the book of reincarnation is glowing signaling a new mission. Bolstered by the thought of his past debts being wiped clean Gessho agrees to help Suusu bring back the Northern Mountain Emperor's memories of his former love. Gessho decides to use the void tears against his fearsome opponent but finds himself unprepared for the shrewdness of the youkai and it seems his quest to erase his past life debts won't be going as easy as he thought.

value.title: Il re della distruzione: l'imperatore delle montagne del Nord
value.synopsis: Long ago, there once was a kingdom called Goyou where youkai were forced into servitude using the mother and child talisman. One day, a youkai rebellion occured in that kingdom. Youkai who had spent hundreds of years being oppressed rose up seeking their freedom. That was also the day of the Goyou kingdom's princess's wedding. As the youkai lay siege to the castle a single man faces them in an effort to repel their attack and save the woman he loves. This is the story of the Northern Mountain Emperor.

value.title: Il sogno di Suusu
value.synopsis: With the help of Haku Gessho and Suusu, all of the Northern Mountain Emperor's memories of the time he lived in the Goyou kingdom have been returned. Angered by this, Sashi tries to use the Nightmare Fox to bring the Northern Mountain Emperor back under his control, but is thwarted by the mysterious appearance of the Goyou kingdom's princess from so long ago. Will the Northern Mountain Emperor be able to fulfill the reincarnation matchmaking vow he made as a young boy? Meanwhile, Yaya convinces Haku Gessho to marry Suusu by agreeing to his enormous debt, but Suusu is not thrilled by this turn of events. What does this mean for their future?
